title: Deportation policy 'very strong', says Trump, rules out 'amnesty'
description:
After suggesting he was open to negotiating a deal with Democrats on an immigration policy that he described as too tough, President Donald Trump on Monday defended his administration's deportation policy and said he was opposed to any immigration deal that would include "amnesty" for immigrants living in the US illegally.
The comments from Trump came after Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin earlier Monday also said while he has been fielding calls from Democrats interested in working on immigration policy, he was adamantly opposed to any deal that would include amnesty.
The midterm elections highlighted voters' disaffection toward the administration's hard-line immigration enforcement activities.
